rules: Do not commit source-image bytes to the public repository until publication rights are cleared.
Do not replace a missing question image with an explanatory figure from the source.
A source image may link to more than one canonical question when the source text explicitly reuses it.
Image-dependent questions remain non-publishable until clinical image review and publication approval are complete.
